info.name: Diabetes Readmission Intervention Queue API
info.description:
All endpoints of the FastAPI service in backend/main.py (v1.1.0).

Run order: the requests chain through collection variables. 'List encounters' sets sampleEncounterId and 'Get high-risk care queue' sets queueEncounterId, which the Interventions folder uses. The last successful intervention request resets the record to PENDING_REVIEW.

If PostgreSQL is unreachable, every database-backed endpoint returns 503.

Learning prototype only - not for clinical decision-making.
